instruction: Right now you're facing a cupboard with a lamp on it. Turn right and exit the bedroom. Now you can find a narrow passage. Walk through the narrow passage till you reach an opened door in front of you. Now turn right and walk in the, in that passage passing three portraits on the left side and a cupboard on the right side. Now there is an entrance towards a room on the left side. Move towards that and stand at the entrance and that is the end point.
